parts.title: Pieces in this file
parts.pdf.how: Each row becomes a piece of its own in the library, made of its pages. The rows start from the page bookmarks. Pages are counted in this file, as the bar shows them, not as printed. Nothing is cut: this piece stays as it is.
parts.pdf.none: No pieces yet. Add a piece from its first page, or bookmark the page where each piece starts.
parts.pdf.outside: Piece {0}: its pages run from 1 to {1}, the first not after the last.
parts.pdf.overlap: Piece {0} starts before piece {1} ends: the pieces' pages go in order and do not overlap.
parts.pdf.copyFailed: {0} could not be copied from the PDF.
parts.pdf.inLibrary: They are in the library and in the playlist. Each opens as a PDF of its own pages, and “Recognise notes” reads only them.
pdf.title: PDF
pdf.noBookmarks: No pages bookmarked yet. The bookmark in the bar marks the page you are on.
photos.readKeeps: Each page shows when it is done, and a page can be sent again. Then Open the notes puts them into this same piece, with the bars to check; your photos and marks stay as they are.
photos.readLine: Each photo goes on its own to the scan server at {0}, which deletes it once read. The photos stay here as they are.
pieces.suggestHow: Suggest where the pieces begin from the notes read, or start from the pieces kept; Confirm the pieces keeps them in the piece, on every device.
pieces.noSuggestion: No pieces can be suggested from the notes read here.
